many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

steps.input:
import json
n=17; center=n//2
G=[]
for r in range(n):
 row=[0]*n
 lo=max(0,center-r); hi=min(n-1,center+r)
 if r<=center:
  row[center-r]=2; row[center+r]=2
 for c in range(lo,hi+1):
  if (c-(r+center))%4==0 and row[c]==0:
   row[c]=1
 G.append(row)
assert len(G)==17 and all(len(x)==17 for x in G)
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':G},separators=(',',':')))
